title: Battle Presentation Layer Refactor
summary: Behavior-preserving split of the client battle presentation layer: staging.ts god-file (1941 -> 1094 lines) into staging-seed.ts / staging-fx.ts (one consolidated EffectLoop + HitStop owning hit-stop and the VFX subsystems) / move-fx.ts pure data module; shared battleUI.ts deduping spar-vs-cup screen logic (reasonLine, winningSideKey, castFighter, kit picker, tactic row, focus trap, speed button); one disposeObject3D utility across 7 sites; CSS class-ownership cleanup with mock.css scoped under .mock; a11y additions (cup give-up modal dialog role/aria-modal/focus trap/Escape/focus restore, aria-pressed fast-forward, spar overlay focus return). Phase 4 headless visual QA caught and fixed an EffectLoop default-binding regression (Illegal invocation on every projectile/burst) now covered by a red-verified regression test.
